manifest.name: Four in a Row
manifest.plain: A game of Four in a Row against Juli, played when you open it. Juli plays to win and every move is her own: her model picks it on this phone, with the game's read of the board. It keeps the game and the score on this phone and never goes online. Win 10 in a row to unlock a new opponent.
manifest.description: Four in a Row against Juli: drop discs and get four in a row across, down or diagonally before she does. Juli plays to win and every move is her own, picked on this phone. Fits: four in a row, a disc-dropping board game, a quick board game with Juli.
manifest.author: p0pc0rn

title.desc: the game's name, e.g. Four in a Row

player_name.desc: the person's name on the score, e.g. You

juli_name.desc: Juli's name on the score, e.g. Juli

juli_color.desc: Juli's discs, #rrggbb, easy to tell from the person's

board_color.desc: the board, #rrggbb, unlike both disc colours

win_text.desc: the title when the person wins

notes_for_juli: Fill names and colours from the request. Keep the two disc colours easy to tell apart and the board a third, darker colour. first = who drops the first disc ('take turns' changes each game). Juli always plays her best: there are no levels. Keep win_text and juli_win_text short: they are big titles. Example for 'four in a row with green and purple, I go first': title Four in a Row, player_color #2ecc71, juli_color #9b59b6, board_color #1f3b73, first you. The person unlocks a second opponent (Juli with the Bigger brain) with 10 wins in a row: nothing to fill for it.

skills.play-four-in-a-row:
---
name: play-four-in-a-row
description: How Juli picks a strong Four in a Row move from the columns the game offers: win now, block the person, follow the game's read, build from the middle.
for: [game]
---
## Each move, in this order
1. If a column wins for you now, take it.
2. If the person wins next in a column, take that column to block it.
3. Never drop a disc where the person can win right on top of it.
4. Otherwise take the game hint's first choice; early in the game the middle is strongest: column D, then C or E.
5. Build lines of three that still have room for a fourth disc; two such threats at once win.

## Reading the game
- The game lists only the columns you may play; a full column is never offered.
- A disc falls to the lowest empty place in its column.
- The game's hint says what each of YOUR choices leads to, looking many moves ahead, strongest first: "wins now" wins at once; "loses at once" means the person wins right after you play it, so never pick it; "even" means no sure result yet.
- Answer with the number of the choice, not the column letter.
